codeReview.summary: The fix addresses the two originally reported parity gaps (binary -c/-l handling and invert-match max-count basis), but introduces a new blocking max-count edge-case regression in --nomultiline + -v when --max-count=0.

issues.description: In search_text_line_by_line(), scan_end uses .nth(opts.max_count - 1), which underflows at --max-count=0. This causes a debug panic (`attempt to subtract with overflow`) and release-mode parity break. Repro: `cargo run -q -p rust-ag -- --nocolor --nomultiline -m0 -v NEEDLE tests/edge-cases/max-count/few-matches.txt` panics, while baseline `./ag --nocolor --nomultiline -m0 -v ...` exits 0 with only non-matching lines and no ERR diagnostic.

summary: Reviewed fix transcript skeleton plus both diffs (89d4bad and 4df8c50). Original failures are targeted, but the fix is not ready to pass due to a new blocking max-count=0 invert-match regression in line-by-line mode.
